versos.e: .Joined with the people of Judah and Benjamin in the renewal of the Passover 2Ch 15:9; with 15:1-15
.Stood on Mount Gerizim to bless at the time of the recounting of the law of Moses De 27:12
.With Levi avenges upon the Shechemites the seduction of Dinah Ge 34; 49:5-7
.Goes down into Egypt to buy corn (graini); is imprisoned by Joseph, and is de- tained Ge 42:24,36; 43:23
.Blesses Jesus (when an infant) in the temple Lu 2:25-35
.Place of, in camping and marching Nu 2:12; 10:18,19
